title: MGS5VR implemented behavior regression catalog
scope: Behavior families found in current source and retained public ledgers. This is an explicit audit denominator, not an exhaustive list of every weapon, action, mission, report or supported environment.

baseline.comparison: The published build predates the current handheld-default/animation/performance candidate. Historical released-build still captures cannot clear a newer continuous native regression.
baseline.current_candidate: Unreleased handheld-default, animation and performance investigation. Candidate 4df840eda253 passed 43 CTest groups and installer transactions; current ACC observations remain scoped. Exact process/configuration identities are retained locally.

rules: Source presence is implementation evidence, not a feature-complete claim.
A CTest group maps to only the checks described by automated.scope; passing it is not native gameplay acceptance.
A tracked native fixture is a repeatable test definition, not proof that it ran or passed.
Retained scoped observations belong to their original candidate and scene. They do not automatically pass the current candidate.
Continuous native visuals must cover the transition, preserve native animation and inspect both eyes where stereo matters. Endpoint-only captures do not close temporal defects.
Newer reproduced failures override older scoped passes for the affected behavior.
Current candidate continuous and headset passes are zero until explicitly promoted. Historical feedback is not a headset pass.
Do not infer runtime FPS from capture FPS or count a source catalog/item definition as a tested gameplay result.
Source, test and fixture references must be repository-relative public paths. Do not add private paths, game installations, saves, binaries or evidence hashes.
Blocked features prohibit a release claim that the affected repair is accepted. Experimental features stay explicitly unproven and opt-in where configured.

automated.partial: Some directly related isolated contracts exist; complete behavior not exercised.

native.scoped_observation: Current native measurements or bounded observations exist; complete feature acceptance remains open.
native.retained_scoped: Retained native observations exist from an earlier identified run/build; not a current blanket pass.
native.unverified: No accepted native outcome for the stated behavior.
native.blocked: A current reported or reproduced defect prevents acceptance; its scope explicitly distinguishes a user report from native reproduction.
native.not_applicable: External tooling uses a different acceptance method.
native.accepted_scoped: Reviewed current-candidate native evidence with a matching public report and controlled local acceptance ID; only its declared scope.

continuous.historical_partial: A bounded historical continuous take exists, with explicit limitations.
continuous.unverified: No current continuous acceptance for the complete behavior.
continuous.blocked: Current continuous evidence reveals a defect.
continuous.not_applicable: Native gameplay recording does not directly accept this external tool.
continuous.accepted: Reviewed current-candidate native transition recording with the required sustained duration and repetition count; no headset or full-game inference.

headset.historical_feedback: Older physical feedback exists and may include defects; not current acceptance.
headset.accepted: Reviewed current-candidate physical headset session identified by hardware/runtime; only its declared scope.

release_gate.blocked: Known current defect requires repair/replay before acceptance.
release_gate.pending: Missing native, continuous, headset or scenario coverage.
release_gate.experimental: Unproven or incomplete experiment; exclude accepted-feature claims.
release_gate.tooling_only: Contracts cover external tooling; end-user environments remain separate.

sustained_acceptance_policy.purpose: A bounded humanlike regression includes minutes of movement, repeated interactions, natural neutral releases, interruptions and complete transitions. It cannot be accepted by one click and an after-state screenshot.
sustained_acceptance_policy.evidence: Keep native state/input results, exact build/config/process identity, source-frame/pose joins, final-eye capture timestamps and timing counters in the controlled acceptance record. Public catalog stores status and scope only.
sustained_acceptance_policy.frame_rate_rule: Report actual recording cadence separately from native CPU/GPU and fresh XR submissions/repeats. No interpolation and no zero-drop claim from sparse captures.
sustained_acceptance_policy.unavailable_scene_rule: Unavailable native state, hardware or progression is an explicit unverified gate. Do not force the scene, bypass tutorial progress or count a mock as native evidence.

source_inventory_rule: Every current file under src/ and include/ must have at least one feature source_paths reference. Public source additions/deletions require explicit catalog review.
